# relay_workspace (Data Source)

Reads an existing workspace by name or ID, for workspaces not managed by this configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_workspace" "prod" {
  name = "prod"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Workspace ID.
- `name` (String) Workspace name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organization's default workspace.
- `managed_by` (String) Owner tag, empty when unmanaged.
- `slug` (String) URL slug.
